insights.data_profile: The dataset contains 164,808 records across 2 features (2 numerical, 0 categorical). The dataset is complete — no missing values detected. Outliers were detected in 1 column(s) using the IQR method — these were retained for training but may warrant domain investigation. | Pipeline: median imputation for continuous features (resistant to skew), mode imputation for categoricals. IQR-based outlier flagging applied. One-Hot Encoding via pd.get_dummies (drop_first=True to avoid multicollinearity).
insights.task: A Regression problem was detected because the target column 'industry_id' holds continuous numerical values. The model will predict quantities — such as energy consumption, machine temperature, or throughput rate. | Stratified 80/20 train-test split applied (stratify=y for classification). No data leakage — preprocessing fit exclusively on training fold.
insights.model: After training and comparing all recommended models, XGBoost Regressor achieved the best performance. It minimised the Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) to 597.1024 with an R² of 0.0167, explaining 1.7% of the variance in the target variable. | Model selection criterion: weighted F1 (classification) or RMSE (regression). All models trained with default hyperparameters; recommend GridSearchCV / Optuna for production hyperparameter optimisation.
insights.features: The top predictive features are 'job_id'. These variables carry the highest statistical weight in the model's decision process. In an industrial context, focusing data quality efforts on these columns will yield the greatest improvement in prediction accuracy. | Importances sourced from estimator's native feature_importances_ (tree-based) or mean(|coef_|) (linear). For model-agnostic explanations, integrate SHAP TreeExplainer / KernelExplainer.
insights.preprocessing: Numerical missing values filled using median imputation. All features standardised to zero mean and unit variance (StandardScaler). Final feature matrix contains 1 columns after encoding. | StandardScaler fitted on X_train only; transform applied to both train/test to prevent test-set leakage. Boolean dummy columns cast to int8 for memory efficiency.
